author: meghna mukerjee
content: We used Dancing Cubs to hire the jungle ballpit for our son's third birthday, and from the first contact to delivery to pick up everything was perfect. The website was so easy to navigate, we got all the details of the ball pond easily, and Zara was very helpful with more information. She was regularly in touch. Matt who did the delivery and pick up was very professional. Clean and sturdy equipment, exactly as photographed, and lots of fun for everyone! We will definitely be using again. Thanks Dancing Cubs team!
